newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates lower.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates lower.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in a flush private sector market to between 9-1/2 and 10 percent on Thursday from a range of 10 and 10-1/2 percent on Wednesday, bankers said.
One-week rates were also lower at around 10 percent from between 10 and 10-1/4 percent.
"The market is extremely liquid. It's the end of the week, right after the (four-day) Eid holiday and several banks did not get the t-bills they had asked for,"one banker said.
The Central Bank said on Thursday it had accepted bids for three month treasury bills for 768.725 million pounds from submitted bids worth a total 884.225 million.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
